# proxmox_pool (Resource)

Manages Proxmox VE pools through `/pools`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "proxmox_pool" "platform" {
  pool_id     = "platform"
  comment     = "Managed by Terraform"
  vm_ids      = [101, 102]
  storage_ids = ["local-lvm"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `pool_id` (String) Pool identifier.

### Optional

- `allow_move` (Boolean) Allow adding a guest that already belongs to another pool.
- `comment` (String) Optional pool comment.
- `storage_ids` (Set of String) Storage IDs managed as members of this pool.
- `vm_ids` (Set of Number) Guest VMIDs managed as members of this pool.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Pool identifier.
- `members` (Attributes List) Resolved pool members returned by Proxmox. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String)
- `node` (String)
- `storage_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
- `vm_id` (Number)
